fixes.explanation: Nice try, friend, but this verse is about Paul's own reach, not a lineup of teachers. He hopes his area of influence among the Corinthians will greatly increase as their faith increases (2 Corinthians 10:15). And that area isn't one he picked for himself. He calls it the field of influence God assigned him, and he says he was the first to reach them with the gospel of Christ (2 Corinthians 10:13–14).
